title: Converting between fractions, decimals and percent

blocks.content: Percent, decimals and fractions are three ways of saying the same thing. Being able to switch between them is a powerful skill.
Percent means 'out of 100'. So 50% means 50 out of 100, which as a decimal is 0.5.

blocks.rule: To change a percent to a decimal, divide by 100.

blocks.content: To change a simple fraction to a percent, rename it so the bottom is 100.

blocks.explain: 1/2 is the same as 50/100, which is 50%.
blocks.rule: To change a fraction to a percent, make the bottom 100.

blocks.content: Percent is out of 100. Divide by 100 to get a decimal, and make the bottom 100 to get a percent. Let's practise!
